argument_docs.loc: location vector; required at the C boundary
argument_docs.shape: shape, not covariance; lower triangle used; all entries finite
argument_docs.df: degrees of freedom, > 0; +infinity gives the normal limit
argument_docs.allow_singular: 0 reject singular shape; 1 permit singular shape
argument_docs.value: native scalar density, log density or entropy; numerical NaN/infinity retained
argument_docs.status: 0 success/valid scalar call; 1 invalid shape or flag; native parameter errors 2
argument_docs.m: retained dimension, >= 1; unique indices imply m <= n
argument_docs.dimensions: shape (m); unique one-based indices in [1,n], in requested order
argument_docs.marginal_loc: shape (m); selected location vector, in requested order
argument_docs.marginal_shape: shape (m,m); selected symmetric matrix from the lower input triangle
